hypotheses.claim: A host with MAC aabb.cc00.8099 (not edge-h7's configured aabb.cc00.8007) appeared on Gi0/3 and tripped port security in shutdown mode, so the port is err-disabled.
edge-h7's NIC or host was replaced, so the committed secure MAC aabb.cc00.8007 is stale and the port will trip again after recovery unless intent is updated.
The port stays down because psecure-violation has no auto-recovery timer on s5.

shown.rationale: Gi0/3 on s5 is err-disabled by psecure-violation. The port allows one MAC, and the last source address, aabb.cc00.8099 on VLAN 10, is not the secure MAC that intent configures (aabb.cc00.8007). The device's own errdisable recovery timer for psecure-violation is disabled, so the port stays down until someone recovers it. s5 matches its golden and intent, so this is not configuration drift.
